observations: Blue industrial gear box with a flanged input end.
A metal shaft protrudes from the right side.
A black identification plate is mounted on the side.
The unit is resting on a dirt or gravel surface.
A watermark 'CHIDONBEST INDUSTRIAL' is visible across the center.
The shaft appears to be made of cast iron or steel.

claims.evidence: The motor housing is not visible in the photo.
The horsepower rating is not legible on the plate.
The gear ratio is not legible on the plate.

risks.risk: The motor may be non-functional or have seized bearings.
risks.proof: A video showing the motor running or a close-up of the motor terminals.

risks.risk: The gearbox may have internal damage or excessive wear.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being rotated by hand.

risks.risk: The shaft may be cracked or have a broken keyway.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the shaft and the keyway.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Close-up of the motor terminals to check for damage.
Close-up photo of the shaft and the keyway.
Close-up photo of the gearbox housing to check for cracks or wear.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
